requiredActions: Give the Filter & Selection sheet the same responsive chrome split as the Customize Metrics side-sheet: bottom sheet below 768px, right-anchored full-height side drawer (width: min(420px,100vw), no rounded corners, left border) at 768px and above.

Reuse the existing align="none" CSS-only responsive pattern (no breakpoint branching in JS) already established for the Customize Metrics overlay; keep the staged Product/Time/Apply behavior, focus trap, Escape and backdrop dismissal unchanged at every breakpoint.
Remove the arrow-right-up-line nav icon from the Other Focus Metrics 'simple' MetricCard face; keep the card's Link wrapper tappable end-to-end.
Add a 1px solid #E4E4E7 border to every w.metric.card face (compact and simple); leave existing shadow/radius/padding per face unchanged.

Append a muted '(Direct View)'/'(Group View)' suffix to the Performance heading whenever scope=TEAM, driven by filters.teamView (new insights.dashboard.teamViewSuffix key + existing insights.teamView.{DIRECT,GROUP} labels), not by client persona.
